meaning.zh:
“时尚受害者”

这个短语来源于时尚界，用于描述那些盲目追赶时尚潮流，而忽视了自己实际情况的人。英美时尚文化中，这个词往往有点负面的含义，指的是那些不惜一切代价去跟随最新潮流的人，即使这些潮流并不适合他们或是不切实际。
meaning.en: This phrase originates from the fashion world, used to describe those who follow the latest fashion trends blindly without considering their personal circumstances. In Anglo-American fashion culture, this term often carries a slightly negative connotation, referring to those who pursue the latest trends at any cost, even if those trends do not suit them or are impractical.

lines.en: She buys every new design but ends up looking like a *fashion victim*.
lines.zh: 她买了每一款新设计，却最终看起来像个时尚受害者。

lines.en: Don’t be a *fashion victim*. Wear what suits you.
lines.zh: 不要成为时尚受害者。穿适合自己的东西。

lines.en: He was mocked as a *fashion victim* for wearing an overly trendy outfit.
lines.zh: 因为穿了一套过于时髦的衣服，他被嘲笑是一个时尚受害者。
